thread:
alisa: Heads-up — release window opens tomorrow 09:00 PT. Quick sweep for changelog one-liners + format please. If your PR should be listed, add a one-liner under the appropriate component tag in keep-a-changelog and tick the checklist on your PR.

mike: Which components are in scope for this cut?

alisa: core-runtime, console, dedicated, infra, docs. Use this shape for entries:

alisa: ```
- [component] short, user-facing one-liner. (PR #<num> by @handle)
  - tags: bugfix|feature|perf|docs
```

alisa: We try to keep each bullet <= 120 chars. Please avoid internal jargon — phrase it for product release notes.

sasha: Backports — what's the policy this cycle? stable branch names?

alisa: Backport policy unchanged: customer-facing fixes -> backport to stable/1.x. Label with `backport: yes` and include the target branch in the PR title like "backport to stable/1.x". If it's risky, ping me or @jen.

jen: I'll be doing final changelog curation after cutoff at 12:00 PT. If you add late entries, ping me here with the PR link and one-liner.

sam: Added my one-liners for console PRs: 
- [console] improved streaming retry behavior. (PR #2101 by @sam)
- [console] fix layout regression on small screens. (PR #2107 by @sam)

mike: Bump semantics — minor bump for feature/perf, patch for docs/typos? Confirming release versioning so I can tag my change.

alisa: Correct. If the PR includes only docs or tests -> patch. Any user-visible feature or perf change -> minor. We'll bump to next minor unless only patches land.

mike: Thanks. Also: do we want component tags like `[core-runtime]` or coarse ones?

alisa: Keep them coarse: core-runtime, console, dedicated, infra, docs. If you need a subcomponent, add it in parentheses but don't create new top-level tags.

jen: Reminder to run the lint locally before adding: `tools/changelog_lint.py --check`. Common failures: missing PR link, no tag, or too long. Example linter output: 

jen: ```
ERROR: entry must have component tag -> "improved cache eviction"
ERROR: line >120 chars -> "added a huge internal shim that does X (internal details)"
```

sam: Ran the linter, had to shorten two entries and add PR links. All green now. :thumbsup:

sasha: Opened backport PR #2109 -> stable/1.x for the runtime fix.

release-bot: Release freeze in 2 hours — no force pushes to release/* or stable/*, and please avoid non-emergency merges.

jen: I'll cut a sweep at cutoff and consolidate duplicates. If something requires rewording I'll comment on the PR.

mike: Quick Q — internal infra-only changes, do they still go in changelog?

alisa: Yes, but under [infra] and written in terms of impact (e.g., "reduced tail latency for model routing"), not implementation details. If it's purely operational noise, skip it.

sam: Done — PRs updated and one-liners posted. pinging @jen for review.

jen: got them, I'll review during the sweep. thanks all. :raised_hands:

alisa: Appreciated. If anyone hits the lint that they can't fix, paste the error here and I'll help.
